orders_by_hour.query: FROM sales SHOW orders, gross_sales GROUP BY day, hour_of_day SINCE 2026-11-06 UNTIL 2026-11-13 ORDER BY day ASC, hour_of_day ASC LIMIT 200

lp_by_hour_today.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions, sessions_with_cart_additions, sessions_that_completed_checkout WHERE hour_of_day >= 8 AND hour_of_day <= 18 GROUP BY hour_of_day, landing_page_path SINCE 2026-11-13 UNTIL 2026-11-13 ORDER BY hour_of_day ASC, sessions DESC LIMIT 200

home_1316_today.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions, sessions_with_cart_additions WHERE landing_page_path = '/' AND hour_of_day >= 13 AND hour_of_day <= 16 GROUP BY hour_of_day, referrer_source, referrer_name, session_device_type SINCE 2026-11-13 UNTIL 2026-11-13 LIMIT 50
